print("Learned kernel:", gp.kernel_)
pred, std = gp.predict(X, return_std=True)
for i, (yi, pi, si) in enumerate(zip(y, pred, std), 1):
    print(f"Iter {i}: obs={yi:.4f}, pred={pi:.4f}, std={si:.4f}")
